hold.title: What is Secured Delivery?
hold.reason: Says Secured Delivery does not cover loss. Correct: lost -> reprint/refund, late -> 20% refund (Anna-only folder). Released automatically once the text is corrected.

hold.title: How long does an artwork check take?
hold.reason: Times differ from operations (about 70% autocheck in ~5 min, manual 30-60 min; Anna-only folder). Released automatically once the text is corrected.

hold.title: How do I file a complaint?
hold.reason: Says complaints must be reported within 10 days. The complaint policy (Complaint Term 26) uses 14 days from delivery; the policy decides. Released automatically once the text no longer says 10 days.

_note_exclude_articles: Per shop ('shops'): left out only where the covering policy is published AND attached to all of that shop's agents (checked 2026-11-06: IE = IE Endlabel + IE HubSpot email + IE New Stack; IT = IT Endlabel + IT HubSpot email). No 'shops' = all shops ('Anna is support' articles). Re-check when policies change.
_note_referrals: A sentence is only removed when it tells the customer to contact Helloprint (verb + us/our team). Sentences with a number (e.g. 'within 14 days') are kept. Every removed sentence is listed in the report.
